thesisQuality.basis: Operating momentum, diversified critical-material exposure and concrete Winu social-licence evidence support the thesis; commodity cyclicality and execution remain constraints.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: 2025 EBITDA and operating cash flow improved and 2026 operating updates show volume and copper cost-guidance progress.

catalystScore.basis: Rincon financing and its stated 2028 first-production checkpoint create a dated catalyst alongside measurable 2026 operating ramps; execution remains prospective.

governancePower.basis: The Winu Project Agreement provides concrete consent and governance evidence; it does not establish FID or project economics.

alignment2036.basis: Copper, aluminium and lithium capacity pathways are directly exposed to electrification and infrastructure material demand.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Rio Tinto explicitly combined Lithium with Aluminium to deploy shared productivity systems and unified iron-ore operations to share technology and operating practices; realized financial benefit is not yet quantified.

bottleneckControl.basis: Existing diversified production plus commissioned/proposed copper, aluminium and lithium capacity addresses physical critical-material supply constraints.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Commodity diversification reduces single-commodity dependence, but cash generation remains sensitive to commodity prices, costs and project execution.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Operating and ramp evidence spans iron ore, copper, aluminium and lithium across multiple geographies.

pricingPower.basis: H1 2025 aluminium realized pricing included market and value-added-product premiums, with a $292/t VAP premium and VAP at 46% of primary metal sold; evidence is aluminium-specific and does not establish group-wide pricing power.

overallRisk.basis: Commodity-price and cost sensitivity, greenfield Rincon execution and environmental exposure, and prospective Winu economics remain material despite diversification and concrete milestones.

overall.note: Identity and tradability are validated; source lineage has no missing lineage and supported fields are backed by primary or independent-primary evidence. Full-score confidence remains incomplete because two Methodology 1.0 components lack source-addressed evidence.

limitations: No scoreRecord is emitted because two Methodology 1.0 components remain unsupported.
Cross-division evidence establishes an operating mechanism but not quantified realized benefit.
Pricing-power evidence is aluminium-specific and is not extrapolated group-wide.
Prospective project outcomes are not treated as realized.
